name: Markdown
description: Renders a markdown source string as structured content — headings, paragraphs, lists, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, and inline emphasis/strong/code/links — realized from the component's anatomy parts. Text is literal by construction: raw HTML in the source never interprets, and link hrefs are protocol-sanitized.

members.name: content
members.description: Markdown source text. The value is parsed by the shared pure markdown parser and rendered as text-only structural content; it is never treated as HTML.

root.description: Structural container; the markdown tree renders inside it.

heading.description: Heading block (level carried by data-level; tag fixed per contract).

paragraph.description: Paragraph block; soft-wrapped source lines join into one paragraph.

listItem.description: Single list entry; children are inline marks.

codeBlock.description: Fenced code block; literal text only (no nested parsing), language carried by data-language.

blockquote.description: Blockquote block; single-level, content parsed as one paragraph of marks.

emphasis.description: Inline emphasis mark; children are marks.

code.description: Inline code span; literal text only.

link.description: Inline link; href is protocol-sanitized at parse time — unsafe targets degrade to literal child text.
